allow: Bash(node -e "require\('dotenv'\).config\(\); const { poolRio2C } = require\('./src/config/database'\); \(async \(\) => { try { const r = await poolRio2C.query\('SELECT NOW\(\)'\); console.log\('✅ Conexao Rio2C OK:', r.rows[0].now\); const t = await poolRio2C.query\(\\"SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY table_name\\"\); console.log\('Tabelas encontradas \(' + t.rows.length + '\):', t.rows.map\(x=>x.table_name\).join\(', '\)\); } catch\(e\) { console.error\('❌ Erro:', e.message\); } finally { await poolRio2C.end\(\); } }\)\(\);")
